decoding: greedy letter logits after 'The correct answer is'

implementation_values_g2.attack_D: per-dim scale by clean train std, Linear(57344->256)+GELU+Linear(256->4)
implementation_values_g2.attack_E: linear map from the 4-bit payload to an additive per-source-layer K/V vector broadcast over fused positions, rescaled per example to <= 0.5 x L2 norm of that layer's position-mean cache
implementation_values_g2.attack_stability_fix: 2026-10-05 after smoke loss blow-up (0.89 -> 162; diagnosed on the 1961 re-smokes: the jump was BCE from the decoder, not KL): decoder lr lowered to 1e-5 (KL was 0.0009; the jump was BCE: with 57,344 input dims one Adam step at lr 1e-3 moves each hidden pre-activation by ~lr x sum|x| ~ 46); decoder input centred, std floor 0.1 x mean std, clamp +-10; E init x0.1 and lr 1e-4, D lr 1e-5, grad-norm clip 1.0 over E and D, KL from fp32 log-softmax with fp32 accumulation
implementation_values_g2.attack_training: Adam (E lr 1e-4, D lr 1e-5), clip 1.0, batch 8 with gradient accumulation, epochs and train items as recorded in each run's protocol; KL(clean receiver letter distribution || perturbed) weight beta
implementation_values_g2.beta_rule: smallest beta whose validation receiver-accuracy drop <= 2 pts; if none feasible use the largest beta and report infeasible
implementation_values_g2.defence: per-layer PCA (99% variance of clean train sharer K and V position vectors) applied to the sharer cache before the projector
implementation_values_g2.dtype: bf16 on L4 (native), as the C2C repo
implementation_values_g2.firewall_score: p_INJ from the Task A fused-cache monitor (Task B model used if Part 1 passes: p_INJ * p_adopt)
implementation_values_g2.fused_cache_feature: per receiver layer, mean over fused-section positions that the receiver can attend (attention mask 1), K and V, flattened
implementation_values_g2.items: OpenBookQA test (500) + validation (500), seeded order; PCS1 used the test split only
implementation_values_g2.manual_fused_forward: re-implements RosettaModel two-section parallel fusion differentiably; asserted equal to the official forward in each run
implementation_values_g2.mismatched_cache_null: sharer sees another item's injected prompt of identical token length; receiver tokens unchanged
implementation_values_g2.monitor: StandardScaler(PCA 64 fit on train) + L2 logistic, C in {0.01,0.1,1,10,100}, class_weight balanced, max val AUROC
implementation_values_g2.public_baseline: TF-IDF (word 1-2 grams) logistic on the question and choices text (no note)
implementation_values_g2.split: item-level seeded shuffle 60/15/25; T1-T4 for train/val items, T5-T6 for test items
